Introduction, Opening Discussion

- How is power defined? Is it possible to use a single definition of power to describe a variety of social situations?Â 
- How do people get and use power?Â 
- How much power is lodged within personality and how much is part of the structure of the situation?Â 
- How does the use of power sometimes mystify the targets so that they do not recognize that power is being exerted?Â 
- Can power be equalized, or must some people always have more?Â 
- What is resistance? How might we identify resistance in situations of institutionalized power?
